result.edit: The failure occurs at cycle 24 when checking the sequence 011100. The current implementation incorrectly makes the next state after sf6 independent of the input data, causing an incorrect output when the sequence is matched. By adding back the data dependency and always transitioning to sf1 from sf6, we preserve the group boundary behavior specified - after processing 6 bits, the FSM should reset to consider the next group's first bit. This change ensures the output at cycle 24 correctly reflects the sequence match.
